Location: FKiSS Actions > quit
Action: Quit()
Related Events: end
See also: FKiSS, Events, Actions

quit()

First defined in: FKiSS1b
The quit action closes the KiSS doll.
This may trigger the end event.
Not all KiSS viewers support this action the same way. Some viewers close just the doll, some close the whole viewer, some will ignore the command.

Example:

;@ quit()
Location: FKiSS Actions > quit
